answers.content: Configure the Lambda functions to log the tenant ID and the number of RCUs and WCUs consumed from DynamoDB for each transaction to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Deploy another Lambda function to calculate the tenant costs by using the logged capacity units and the overall DynamoDB cost from the AWS Cost Explorer API. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the calculation Lambda function on a schedule.
answers.explanation: Requires custom logging and calculation Lambda functions, increasing operational complexity.

answers.content: Create a new partition key that associates DynamoDB items with individual tenants. Deploy a Lambda function to populate the new column as part of each transaction. Deploy another Lambda function to calculate the tenant costs by using Amazon Athena to calculate the number of tenant items from DynamoDB and the overall DynamoDB cost from the AWS CUR. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the calculation Lambda function on a schedule.
answers.explanation: Involves schema changes and custom cost calculation, which is complex and not necessary for cost allocation.

answers.content: Deploy a Lambda function to log the tenant ID, the size of each response, and the duration of the transaction call as custom metrics to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use CloudWatch Logs Insights to query the custom metrics for each tenant. Use AWS Pricing Calculator to obtain the overall DynamoDB costs and to calculate the tenant costs.
answers.explanation: Relies on custom CloudWatch metrics and manual use of pricing calculator, which is less precise and more operationally intensive.

questions.content: A startup company recently migrated a large ecommerce website to AWS. The website has experienced a 70% increase in sales. Software engineers are using a private GitHub repository to manage codThe DevOps team is using Jenkins for builds and unit testing. The engineers need to receive notifications for bad builds and zero downtime during deployments. The engineers also need to ensure any changes to production are seamless for users and can be rolled back in the event of a major issu The software engineers have decided to use AWS CodePipeline to manage their build and deployment process.  Which solution will meet these requirements?

answers.content: Use GitHub websockets to trigger the CodePipeline pipelinUse the Jenkins plugin for AWS CodeBuild to conduct unit testing. Send alerts to an Amazon SNS topic for any bad builds. Deploy in an in-place, all-at-once deployment configuration using AWS CodeDeploy.
answers.explanation: In-place, all-at-once deployments do not ensure zero downtime or seamless rollback.

answers.content: Use GitHub webhooks to trigger the CodePipeline pipelinUse the Jenkins plugin for AWS CodeBuild to conduct unit testing. Send alerts to an Amazon SNS topic for any bad builds. Deploy in a blue/green deployment using AWS CodeDeploy.
answers.explanation: GitHub webhooks are the correct mechanism to trigger CodePipeline as they provide event-based notifications from GitHub. Using the Jenkins plugin for AWS CodeBuild aligns with the existing Jenkins-based unit testing workflow. Sending alerts to an Amazon SNS topic for bad builds provides immediate notification, which is a best practicDeploying with a blue/green deployment strategy using AWS CodeDeploy ensures zero downtime and the ability to roll back to a stable version if issues occur.

answers.content: Use GitHub websockets to trigger the CodePipeline pipelinUse AWS X-Ray for unit testing and static code analysis. Send alerts to an Amazon SNS topic for any bad builds. Deploy in a blue/green deployment using AWS CodeDeploy.
answers.explanation: GitHub websockets are not the standard or recommended trigger mechanism; also, AWS X-Ray is not used for unit testing.

answers.content: Use GitHub webhooks to trigger the CodePipeline pipelinUse AWS X-Ray for unit testing and static code analysis. Send alerts to an Amazon SNS topic for any bad builds. Deploy in an in-place, all-at-once deployment configuration using AWS CodeDeploy.
answers.explanation: AWS X-Ray is not used for unit testing; also, in-place deployments do not ensure zero downtime.

questions.content: A retail company is mounting IoT sensors in all of its stores worldwidDuring the manufacturing of each sensor, the company’s private certificate authority (CA) issues an X.509 certificate that contains a unique serial number. The company then deploys each certificate to its respective sensor.  A solutions architect needs to give the sensors the ability to send data to AWS after they are installed. Sensors must not be able to send data to AWS until they are installed.  Which solution will meet these requirements?

answers.content: Create an AWS Lambda function that can validate the serial number. Create an AWS IoT Core provisioning templatInclude the SerialNumber parameter in the Parameters section. Add the Lambda function as a pre-provisioning hook. During manufacturing, call the RegisterThing API operation and specify the template and parameters.
answers.explanation: Calling RegisterThing during manufacturing does not prevent pre-installation communication and is less secure than validating at installation.

answers.content: Create an AWS Step Functions state machine that can validate the serial number. Create an AWS IoT Core provisioning templatInclude the SerialNumber parameter in the Parameters section. Specify the Step Functions state machine to validate parameters. Call the StartThingRegistrationTask API operation during installation.
answers.explanation: Using Step Functions for serial number validation is more complex and less standard than using Lambda pre-provisioning hooks.

answers.content: Create an AWS Lambda function that can validate the serial number. Create an AWS IoT Core provisioning templatInclude the SerialNumber parameter in the Parameters section. Add the Lambda function as a pre-provisioning hook. Register the CA with AWS IoT Core, specify the provisioning template, and set the allow-auto-registration parameter.
answers.explanation: AWS IoT Core requires that client certificates be registered before devices can communicate with IoT Core, ensuring the devices cannot send data before being authorized. Using an AWS Lambda function as a pre-provisioning hook to validate the serial number in the provisioning template aligns with best practices for secure and controlled device onboarding. Registering the CA with AWS IoT Core and setting the allow-auto-registration parameter while using the provision template with serial number validation provides a managed, secure way to automate trusted device provisioning.

answers.content: Create an AWS IoT Core provisioning templatInclude the SerialNumber parameter in the Parameters section. Include parameter validation in the templatProvision a claim certificate and a private key for each device that uses the CA. Grant AWS IoT Core service permissions to update AWS IoT things during provisioning.
answers.explanation: Provisioning claim certificates for each device undermines security best practices by allowing devices to connect before installation.

questions.content: A company has an application that uses an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster for the application's databasThe DB cluster contains one small primary instance and three larger replica instances. The application runs on an AWS Lambda function. The application makes many short-lived connections to the database's replica instances to perform read-only operations.  During periods of high traffic, the application becomes unreliable and the database reports that too many connections are being established. The frequency of high-traffic periods is unpredictabl Which solution will improve the reliability of the application?

answers.content: Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy for the DB cluster. Configure a read-only endpoint for the proxy. Update the Lambda function to connect to the proxy endpoint.
answers.explanation: Amazon RDS Proxy is a managed service that improves database efficiency by pooling and sharing established connections, thus reducing the number of new connections to the databasUsing a read-only endpoint on the proxy aligns with the application's use case for read-only operations on the replica instances. Updating the Lambda function to connect to the proxy endpoint leverages connection pooling, which is essential for handling unpredictable high traffic with many short-lived connections. Increasing max_connections or scaling based on DatabaseConnections do not address connection storm problems as effectively as a connection pooler like RDS Proxy. The Aurora Data API is not applicable for Aurora PostgreSQL clusters and configuring a read-only endpoint for the Aurora Data API on the proxy is not a valid option.

answers.content: Increase the max_connections setting on the DB cluster's parameter group. Reboot all the instances in the DB cluster. Update the Lambda function to connect to the DB cluster endpoint.
answers.explanation: Increasing max_connections treats the symptom and can lead to resource exhaustion without solving connection overhead.

answers.content: Configure instance scaling for the DB cluster to occur when the DatabaseConnections metric is close to the max connections setting. Update the Lambda function to connect to the Aurora reader endpoint.
answers.explanation: Scaling instances based on DatabaseConnections is reactive and does not prevent connection storms or reduce connection overhead; it may also increase cost without improving reliability during unpredictable spikes.

answers.content: Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy for the DB cluster. Configure a read-only endpoint for the Aurora Data API on the proxy. Update the Lambda function to connect to the proxy endpoint.
answers.explanation: Amazon RDS Proxy does not support configuring a read-only endpoint for the Aurora Data API; this option is invalid.

questions.content: A solutions architect is preparing to deploy a new security tool into several previously unused AWS Regions. The solutions architect will deploy the tool by using an AWS CloudFormation stack set. The stack set's template contains an IAM role that has a custom namUpon creation of the stack set, no stack instances are created successfully.  What should the solutions architect do to deploy the stacks successfully?

answers.content: Enable the new Regions in all relevant accounts. Specify the CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM capability during the creation of the stack set.
answers.explanation: CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM is needed, but simply enabling Regions does not solve permission model or role issues.

answers.content: Use the Service Quotas console to request a quota increase for the number of CloudFormation stacks in each new Region in all relevant accounts. Specify the CAPABILITY_IAM capability during the creation of the stack set.
answers.explanation: CAPABILITY_IAM is insufficient for custom named IAM roles and quota issues are not indicated by the facts.

answers.content: Specify the CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM capability and the SELF_MANAGED permissions model during the creation of the stack set.
answers.explanation: Using the CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM capability is required when creating stacks that include IAM resources with custom names. The key facts mention self-service permissions requiring IAM roles created beforehand, indicating use of the SELF_MANAGED permissions model. StackSets requires an administration role and execution roles for target accounts, consistent with SELF_MANAGED permissions. Enabling new Regions or quota increases are not mentioned as primary issues and CAPABILITY_IAM is insufficient when custom IAM role names are used.

answers.content: Specify an administration role ARN and the CAPABILITY_IAM capability during the creation of the stack set.
answers.explanation: CAPABILITY_IAM does not cover named IAM resources; SELF_MANAGED permissions are needed as per facts.

questions.content: A retail company is operating its ecommerce application on AWS. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company uses an Amazon RDS DB instance as the database backend. Amazon CloudFront is configured with one origin that points to the ALB. Static content is cached. Amazon Route 53 is used to host all public zones.  After an update of the application, the ALB occasionally returns a 502 status code (Bad Gateway) error. The root cause is malformed HTTP headers that are returned to the ALB. The webpage returns successfully when a solutions architect reloads the webpage immediately after the error occurs.  While the company is working on the problem, the solutions architect needs to provide a custom error page instead of the standard ALB error page to visitors.  Which combination of steps will meet this requirement with the LEAST amount of operational overhead? (Choose two.)

answers.content: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket to host a static webpagUpload the custom error pages to Amazon S3.
answers.explanation: Hosting custom error pages on Amazon S3 static website hosting is simple, highly available, and requires minimal ongoing management.

answers.content: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke an AWS Lambda function if the ALB health check response Target.FailedHealthChecks is greater than 0. Configure the Lambda function to modify the forwarding rule at the ALB to point to a publicly accessible web server.
answers.explanation: Using CloudWatch alarms and Lambda to dynamically modify ALB forwarding rules adds unnecessary complexity and operational overhead for a temporary issue.

answers.content: Modify the existing Amazon Route 53 records by adding health checks. Configure a fallback target if the health check fails. Modify DNS records to point to a publicly accessible webpage.
answers.explanation: Route 53 health checks operate at DNS level and are not suitable for intermittent 502 errors. DNS failover is slow and coarse-grained.

answers.content: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke an AWS Lambda function if the ALB health check response Elb.InternalError is greater than 0. Configure the Lambda function to modify the forwarding rule at the ALB to point to a public accessible web server.
answers.explanation: Using CloudWatch alarms and Lambda to dynamically modify ALB forwarding rules adds unnecessary complexity and operational overhead for a temporary issue.

answers.content: Add a custom error response by configuring a CloudFront custom error pagModify DNS records to point to a publicly accessible web page.
answers.explanation: Configuring CloudFront custom error responses allows CloudFront to return a custom error page (such as for 502 errors) without changing the ALB, providing the lowest operational overhead.

questions.content: A company has multiple lines of business (LOBs) that roll up to the parent company. The company has asked its solutions architect to develop a solution with the following requirements: • Produce a single AWS invoice for all of the AWS accounts used by its LOBs. • The costs for each LOB account should be broken out on the invoic• Provide the ability to restrict services and features in the LOB accounts, as defined by the company's governance policy. • Each LOB account should be delegated full administrator permissions, regardless of the governance policy.  Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

answers.content: Use AWS Organizations to create an organization in the parent account for each LOB. Then invite each LOB account to the appropriate organization.
answers.explanation: Creating multiple organizations per LOB prevents unified billing and centralized management.

answers.content: Use AWS Organizations to create a single organization in the parent account. Then, invite each LOB's AWS account to join the organization.
answers.explanation: This step is required to meet the billing requirements: producing a single AWS invoice for all accounts and breaking out costs for each LOB account. AWS Organizations enables consolidated billing, where the management account pays all charges and provides detailed cost and usage data for each member account.

answers.content: Implement service quotas to define the services and features that are permitted and apply the quotas to each LOB. as appropriate.
answers.explanation: Service quotas are for limiting resource usage, not for restricting available services or enforcing governance.

answers.content: Create an SCP that allows only approved services and features, then apply the policy to the LOB accounts.
answers.explanation: This step is required to meet the governance requirement of restricting services and features as defined by the company's governance policy. Service Control Policies (SCPs) define the maximum available permissions for all IAM users and roles (including the root user) in the member accounts, acting as guardrails to enforce the company's policy. This restriction applies even if LOB accounts are delegated full administrator permissions locally, ensuring the governance policy is upheld.

answers.content: Enable consolidated billing in the parent account's billing console and link the LOB accounts.
answers.explanation: Consolidated billing is integrated into AWS Organizations; no separate enabling is required and it doesn't enforce service restrictions.

questions.content: A company is deploying a third-party web application on AWS. The application is packaged as a Docker imagThe company has deployed the Docker image as an AWS Fargate service in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). An Application Load Balancer (ALB) directs traffic to the application.  The company needs to give only a specific list of users the ability to access the application from the internet. The company cannot change the application and cannot integrate the application with an identity provider. All users must be authenticated through multi-factor authentication (MFA).  Which solution will meet these requirements?

answers.content: Create a user pool in Amazon Cognito. Configure the pool for the application. Populate the pool with the required users. Configure the pool to require MFConfigure a listener rule on the ALB to require authentication through the Amazon Cognito hosted UI.
answers.explanation: Amazon Cognito user pools provide built-in user management and authentication features, including multi-factor authentication (MFA). ALB listener rules can integrate directly with Amazon Cognito to require authentication before permitting access to the application, which enforces user-level access without modifying the application. The question states the application cannot be changed or integrated with an identity provider, so the solution needs to be external and managed by AWS services; Cognito meets this requirement. IAM-based authentication is not directly supported on ALB listener rules and does not provide user-level authentication for internet-facing applications, making options B and C invalid. AWS Amplify is a development platform, not a user management service, so option D is invalid.

answers.content: Configure the users in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Attach a resource policy to the Fargate service to require users to use MFA. Configure a listener rule on the ALB to require authentication through IAM.
answers.explanation: IAM cannot be directly used to authenticate users on an Application Load Balancer listener rule for user access with MFA.

answers.content: Configure the users in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Enable AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). Configure resource protection for the ALB. Create a resource protection rule to require users to use MFA.
answers.explanation: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) does not integrate with ALB listener rules to enforce MFA on incoming web traffic.

answers.content: Create a user pool in AWS Amplify. Configure the pool for the application. Populate the pool with the required users. Configure the pool to require MFA. Configure a listener rule on the ALB to require authentication through the Amplify hosted UI.
answers.explanation: AWS Amplify does not provide a user pool or authentication mechanism suitable for ALB listener rule integration.

questions.content: In a marine construction project, the project manager is informed by the marine authority that the work permit will not be issued until certain environmental reinforcement work has been completed. After reviewing the project management plan, the reinforcement work is not included in the project scop What should the project manager do?

answers.content: Raise this issue, and review and update the progress report for the next monthly project meeting.
answers.explanation: Raising the issue and updating progress reports is too passive and does not address the necessary scope change.

answers.content: Communicate with an officer in the environmental protection department to check if it is necessary.
answers.explanation: Communicating informally with a department officer does not formalize the required scope adjustment.

answers.content: Organize a meeting with the team and update the work breakdown structure (WBS).
answers.explanation: Updating the work breakdown structure before formal approval bypasses the change control process.

answers.content: Start the organization’s change control process via a change request.
answers.explanation: The environmental reinforcement work is outside the project scope but is required for the permit, indicating a change to the project. Security best practices and project management principles prioritize following formal change control to incorporate necessary scope changes properly. Starting the organization’s change control process via a change request ensures the scope is officially updated and managed. Other options do not address the need to formally adjust the project scope and authorization process.

questions.content: A company's web application has reliability issues. The application serves customers globally. The application runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance and performs read-intensive operations on an Amazon RDS for MySQL databas During high load, the application becomes unresponsive and requires a manual restart of the EC2 instancA solutions architect must improve the application's reliability.  Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?

answers.content: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Specify the EC2 instance as the distribution’s origin. Configure a Multi-AZ deployment for the RDS for MySQL databasUse the standby DB instance for the read-intensive operations.
answers.explanation: Using a Multi-AZ RDS standby instance for read operations is incorrect because standby instances are not accessible for reads, so it doesn't alleviate read load.

answers.content: Run the application on EC2 instances that are in an Auto Scaling group. Place the EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) load balancer. Replace the database service with Amazon Aurora. Use Aurora Replicas for the read-intensive operations.
answers.explanation: Running the application on EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an ELB improves reliability by enabling automatic recovery and scaling during high load. Replacing the database service with Amazon Aurora and using Aurora Replicas for read-intensive operations optimizes database performance and scalability with minimal development effort. This approach follows AWS best practices of using managed services designed for high availability and read scaling. Other options either do not address the application scaling or use standby DB instances, which are not designed for read operations, thus providing less effective solutions.

answers.content: Deploy AWS Global Accelerator. Configure a Multi-AZ deployment for the RDS for MySQL databasUse the standby DB instance for the read-intensive operations.
answers.explanation: AWS Global Accelerator improves network performance but does not directly improve application reliability or database scalability; also uses standby DB instance for reads, which is invalid.

answers.content: Migrate the application to AWS Lambda functions. Create read replicas for the RDS for MySQL databasUse the read replicas for the read-intensive operations.
answers.explanation: Migrating to Lambda involves significant development effort, which contradicts the requirement for least development effort.

questions.content: A solutions architect is creating an AWS CloudFormation template from an existing manually created non-production AWS environment. The CloudFormation template can be destroyed and recreated as needed. The environment contains an Amazon EC2 instancThe EC2 instance has an instance profile that the EC2 instance uses to assume a role in a parent account.  The solutions architect recreates the role in a CloudFormation template and uses the same role namWhen the CloudFormation template is launched in the child account, the EC2 instance can no longer assume the role in the parent account because of insufficient permissions  What should the solutions architect do to resolve this issue?

answers.content: In the parent account, edit the trust policy for the role that the EC2 instance needs to assumEnsure that the target role ARN in the existing statement that allows the sts:AssumeRole action is correct. Save the trust policy.
answers.explanation: Merely verifying the existing statement's target role ARN does not add the missing trust relationship with the child account.

answers.content: In the parent account, edit the trust policy for the role that the EC2 instance needs to assumAdd a statement that allows the sts:AssumeRole action for the root principal of the child account. Save the trust policy.
answers.explanation: The issue arises because the EC2 instance in the child account can no longer assume the role in the parent account due to insufficient trust policy permissions. To allow the EC2 instance in the child account to assume the role in the parent account, the trust policy of the role in the parent account must explicitly allow the child account's root principal to assume the rolAdding a trust policy statement for the root principal of the child account grants the necessary sts:AssumeRole permission. Options related to updating the CloudFormation stack IAM capabilities do not address the cross-account trust relationship needed.

answers.content: Update the CloudFormation stack again. Specify only the CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM capability.
answers.explanation: Specifying CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM alone does not fix trust policy permissions required for cross-account role assumption.

answers.content: Update the CloudFormation stack again. Specify the CAPABILITY_IAM capability and the CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM capability.
answers.explanation: Specifying both CAPABILITY_IAM and CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM addresses stack permission issues but not cross-account trust policy settings.

questions.content: A company needs to improve the reliability of its ticketing application. The application runs on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. The company uses Amazon CloudFront to serve the application. A single ECS service of the ECS cluster is the CloudFront distribution’s origin.  The application allows only a specific number of active users to enter a ticket purchasing flow. These users are identified by an encrypted attribute in their JSON Web Token (JWT). All other users are redirected to a waiting room module until there is available capacity for purchasing.  The application is experiencing high loads. The waiting room module is working as designed, but load on the waiting room is disrupting the applications availability. This disruption is negatively affecting the application's ticket sale transactions.  Which solution will provide the MOST reliability for ticket sale transactions during periods of high load?

answers.content: Create a separate service in the ECS cluster for the waiting room. Use a separate scaling configuration. Ensure that the ticketing service uses the JWT information and appropriately forwards requests to the waiting room service.
answers.explanation: Relies on the ticketing service to forward to the waiting room, increasing coupling and load on the ticketing service.

answers.content: Move the application to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Split the waiting room module into a pod that is separate from the ticketing pod. Make the ticketing pod part of a StatefulSet. Ensure that the ticketing pod uses the JWT information and appropriately forwards requests to the waiting room pod.
answers.explanation: Migrating to EKS adds complexity and does not inherently solve the routing or load isolation problem; StatefulSet is not necessary here.

answers.content: Create a separate service in the ECS cluster for the waiting room. Use a separate scaling configuration. Create a CloudFront function that inspects the JWT information and appropriately forwards requests to the ticketing service or the waiting room service.
answers.explanation: Using a separate ECS service for the waiting room with its own scaling configuration isolates load and enhances reliability for ticket sale transactions. CloudFront functions can inspect JWTs at the edge, efficiently routing requests to the appropriate origin service, reducing load on the main ticketing servicThis approach leverages managed AWS services (ECS and CloudFront) without introducing unnecessary complexity with EKS or mesh services. Separating the waiting room logic outside the main ticketing service aligns with AWS best practices for service isolation and scalability.

answers.content: Move the application to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. Split the waiting room module into a pod that is separate from the ticketing pod. Use AWS App Mesh by provisioning the App Mesh controller for Kubernetes. Enable mTLS authentication and service-to-service authentication for communication between the ticketing pod and the waiting room pod. Ensure that the ticketing pod uses the JWT information and appropriately forwards requests to the waiting room pod.
answers.explanation: Using App Mesh and mTLS adds unnecessary complexity and operational overhead without direct benefit to reliability in this context.

questions.content: A company is deploying a new application on AWS. The application consists of an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster and an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. The EKS cluster has an AWS managed node group.  The company's security guidelines state that all resources on AWS must be continuously scanned for security vulnerabilities.  Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

answers.content: Activate AWS Security Hub. Configure Security Hub to scan the EKS nodes and the ECR repository.
answers.explanation: AWS Security Hub does not perform vulnerability scanning itself; it aggregates findings, so it cannot scan EKS nodes or ECR directly.

answers.content: Activate Amazon Inspector to scan the EKS nodes and the ECR repository.
answers.explanation: Amazon Inspector is designed to automatically scan AWS resources, including EKS nodes and ECR container images, for security vulnerabilities. Using Amazon Inspector involves minimal operational overhead as it is a managed service that continuously monitors for vulnerabilities, meeting the requirement for continuous scanning. AWS Security Hub aggregates findings but does not perform the scanning itself, so it relies on other services like Inspector for vulnerability detection. Deploying a custom EC2 instance for scanning introduces unnecessary operational overhead, which is against the requirement to minimize operational effort. The CloudWatch agent is not designed for vulnerability scanning and does not provide the required continuous scanning capabilities for both EKS nodes and ECR.

answers.content: Launch a new Amazon EC2 instance and install a vulnerability scanning tool from AWS MarketplacConfigure the EC2 instance to scan the EKS nodes. Configure Amazon ECR to perform a basic scan on push.
answers.explanation: Launching and managing an EC2 instance with a marketplace scanning tool increases operational overhead and complexity.

answers.content: Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EKS nodes. Configure the CloudWatch agent to scan continuously. Configure Amazon ECR to perform a basic scan on push.
answers.explanation: The CloudWatch agent is not a vulnerability scanning tool and does not meet the continuous scanning requirement.

questions.content: A company is running a three-tier web application in an on-premises data center. The frontend is served by an Apache web server, the middle tier is a monolithic Java application, and the storage tier is a PostgreSQL databas During a recent marketing promotion, customers could not place orders through the application because the application crashed. An analysis showed that all three tiers were overloaded. The application became unresponsive, and the database reached its capacity limit because of read operations. The company already has several similar promotions scheduled in the near futur A solutions architect must develop a plan for migration to AWS to resolve these issues. The solution must maximize scalability and must minimize operational effort  Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

answers.content: Refactor the frontend so that static assets can be hosted on Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the frontend to customers. Connect the frontend to the Java application.
answers.explanation: Refactoring the frontend to host static assets on Amazon S3 and using Amazon CloudFront maximizes scalability and minimizes operational effort for the web tier. Amazon S3 offers highly scalable, durable storage for static content, and CloudFront (AWS's Content Delivery Network) caches the content globally, reducing latency and offloading traffic from the backend application, which addresses the overload issue. This is a common and highly effective architectural pattern for web applications.

answers.content: Rehost the Apache web server of the frontend on Amazon EC2 instances that are in an Auto Scaling group. Use a load balancer in front of the Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) to host the static assets that the Apache web server needs.
answers.explanation: Rehosting Apache on EC2 with EFS adds operational overhead compared to using S3 and CloudFront.

answers.content: Rehost the Java application in an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment that includes auto scaling.
answers.explanation: Rehosting the monolithic Java application in an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment that includes auto scaling addresses the need for scalability of the middle tier while minimizing operational effort (PaaS model). Elastic Beanstalk automates deployment, scaling, load balancing, and monitoring. Auto scaling ensures that capacity increases automatically to handle peak loads (like during a marketing promotion) and decreases during low-traffic periods.

answers.content: Refactor the Java application, Develop a Docker container to run the Java application. Use AWS Fargate to host the container.
answers.explanation: Refactoring the Java application into a container and using Fargate contradicts the recommendation against refactoring during migration.

answers.content: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to replatform the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL databasUse Aurora Auto Scaling for read replicas.
answers.explanation: Using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to replatform the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database, and using Aurora Auto Scaling for read replicas, addresses the database overload caused by read operations and capacity limits. Aurora is highly scalable and performant. Replatforming to Aurora is a managed service solution that minimizes operational overhead compared to running PostgreSQL on EC2. Implementing Aurora Auto Scaling for read replicas is crucial for handling read-heavy loads, especially during promotions, as it automatically scales the read capacity.

questions.content: A software development company has multiple engineers who are working remotely. The company is running Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) on an Amazon EC2 instancThe company's security policy states that all internal, nonpublic services that are deployed in a VPC must be accessible through a VPN. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) must be used for access to a VPN.  What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

answers.content: Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection. Configure integration between a VPN and AD DS. Use an Amazon WorkSpaces client with MFA support enabled to establish a VPN connection.
answers.explanation: AWS Site-to-Site VPN is intended for network connections, not individual remote user access; WorkSpaces is unrelated to VPN establishment for MFA.

answers.content: Create an AWS Client VPN endpoint. Create an AD Connector directory for integration with AD DS. Enable MFA for AD Connector. Use AWS Client VPN to establish a VPN connection.
answers.explanation: AWS Client VPN supports integration with Active Directory using AD Connector, enabling authentication based on existing AD DS credentials. MFA can be enforced by integrating MFA on AD Connector or on the underlying Active Directory, aligning with the requirement for MFA on VPN access. AWS Client VPN is a managed service designed for remote users to securely access resources in a VPC over a VPN, meeting the security policy requirements. Site-to-Site VPN is intended for network-to-network connections, not for individual remote user access, making Client VPN more appropriate for remote engineers.

answers.content: Create multiple AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections by using AWS VPN CloudHub. Configure integration between AWS VPN CloudHub and AD DS. Use AWS Copilot to establish a VPN connection.
answers.explanation: Site-to-Site VPN and VPN CloudHub are for connecting networks, not for remote user VPN with MFA; AWS Copilot is unrelated to VPN setup.

answers.content: Create an Amazon WorkLink endpoint. Configure integration between Amazon WorkLink and AD DS. Enable MFA in Amazon WorkLink. Use AWS Client VPN to establish a VPN connection.
answers.explanation: Amazon WorkLink is for secure access to internal websites from mobile devices, not for VPN connectivity; mixing WorkLink and Client VPN in this way is incorrect.

questions.content: A company is planning a migration from an on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud. The company plans to use multiple AWS accounts that are managed in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company will create a small number of accounts initially and will add accounts as needed. A solutions architect must design a solution that turns on AWS CloudTrail in all AWS accounts.  What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

answers.content: Create an AWS Lambda function that creates a new CloudTrail trail in all AWS accounts in the organization. Invoke the Lambda function daily by using a scheduled action in Amazon EventBridge.
answers.explanation: Using a Lambda function to create trails in all accounts daily is operationally complex and less efficient than an organization trail.

answers.content: Create a new CloudTrail trail in the organization's management account. Configure the trail to log all events for all AWS accounts in the organization.
answers.explanation: Creating an organization trail from the AWS Organizations management account turns on CloudTrail for all accounts automatically. This approach is operationally efficient because it requires a single setup without needing to create or manage trails manually in each account. AWS best practices support using an organization trail to centrally manage CloudTrail because it simplifies audit and security management. This method leverages the managed AWS service feature of Organizations and CloudTrail integration, reducing operational overhead and complexity.

answers.content: Create a new CloudTrail trail in all AWS accounts in the organization. Create new trails whenever a new account is created. Define an SCP that prevents deletion or modification of trails. Apply the SCP to the root OU.
answers.explanation: Creating and managing individual trails in all accounts and relying on an SCP is manual, less scalable, and more error-prone.

answers.content: Create an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook that creates a CloudTrail trail in all AWS accounts in the organization. Invoke the automation by using Systems Manager State Manager.
answers.explanation: Using Systems Manager Automation and State Manager still involves manual management per account and is less efficient than an organization trail.

questions.content: A company is deploying a distributed in-memory database on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The fleet consists of a primary node and eight worker nodes. The primary node is responsible for monitoring cluster health, accepting user requests, distributing user requests to worker nodes, and sending an aggregate response back to a client. Worker nodes communicate with each other to replicate data partitions.  The company requires the lowest possible networking latency to achieve maximum performanc Which solution will meet these requirements?

answers.content: Launch memory optimized EC2 instances in a partition placement group.
answers.explanation: Partition placement groups are designed to reduce impact of hardware failure rather than optimize for lowest network latency.

answers.content: Launch compute optimized EC2 instances in a partition placement group.
answers.explanation: Compute optimized instances are less suitable than memory optimized instances for an in-memory database workload.

answers.content: Launch memory optimized EC2 instances in a cluster placement group.
answers.explanation: A cluster placement group is designed to provide low-latency, high-throughput networking between EC2 instances, which is critical for distributed in-memory databases requiring fast communication. Memory optimized instances are appropriate because the workload is an in-memory database, which benefits from large memory capacity. Cluster placement groups place instances physically close within a single Availability Zone, minimizing network latency among nodes. Partition placement groups and spread placement groups do not optimize for lowest network latency as cluster placement groups do.

answers.content: Launch compute optimized EC2 instances in a spread placement group.
answers.explanation: Spread placement groups prioritize availability and fault tolerance, not low network latency, which is required here.

questions.content: A solutions architect has deployed a web application that serves users across two AWS Regions under a custom domain. The application uses Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing. The solutions architect has associated weighted record sets with a pair of web servers in separate Availability Zones for each Region.  The solutions architect runs a disaster recovery scenario. When all the web servers in one Region are stopped, Route 53 does not automatically redirect users to the other Region.  Which of the following are possible root causes of this issue? (Choose two.)

answers.content: The weight for the Region where the web servers were stopped is higher than the weight for the other Region.
answers.explanation: Weight configures traffic distribution but does not control failover in the event of endpoint failure.

answers.content: One of the web servers in the secondary Region did not pass its HTTP health check.
answers.explanation: While an unhealthy web server would matter, the issue is about failover not occurring when one Region's servers stop, which implies lack of health evaluation rather than one server in the other Region failing.

answers.content: Latency resource record sets cannot be used in combination with weighted resource record sets.
answers.explanation: Latency-based routing can be combined with weighted record sets; this is allowed and not a cause of the issue.

answers.content: The setting to evaluate target health is not turned on for the latency alias resource record set that is associated with the domain in the Region where the web servers were stopped.
answers.explanation: When using alias records in Route 53, if the alias points to another Route 53 record set (like a latency record set), you must set 'Evaluate Target Health' to 'Yes' for Route 53 to check the health of the records that the alias is pointing to. If this is not enabled, Route 53 continues to route traffic to the latency record set even if its underlying resources (the weighted record sets) are unhealthy or have failed health checks, because the alias record itself is considered healthy. Turning this on allows the failover to the other region when the underlying records in the current region are deemed unhealthy.

answers.content: An HTTP health check has not been set up for one or more of the weighted resource record sets associated with the stopped web servers.
answers.explanation: The weighted record sets are associated with the web servers. If a Route 53 health check is not associated with a specific resource record set, Route 53 assumes the resource is always healthy, even if the web servers are stopped. For failover to occur, the health check must be in place and must fail, indicating the web servers are down, so that Route 53 can redirect traffic to the healthy region.Reference: <https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/route-53-fix-dns-weighted-routing-issue> (If an RRSet in a policy doesn't have an attached health check, then it's always considered healthy.)

questions.content: A software as a service (SaaS) company provides a media software solution to customers. The solution is hosted on 50 VPCs across various AWS Regions and AWS accounts. One of the VPCs is designated as a management VPC. The compute resources in the VPCs work independently.  The company has developed a new feature that requires all 50 VPCs to be able to communicate with each other. The new feature also requires one-way access from each customer's VPC to the company's management VPC. The management VPC hosts a compute resource that validates licenses for the media software solution.  The number of VPCs that the company will use to host the solution will continue to increase as the solution grows.  Which combination of steps will provide the required VPC connectivity with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

answers.content: Create a transit gateway. Attach all the company's VPCs and relevant subnets to the transit gateway.
answers.explanation: AWS Transit Gateway (TGW) is the most scalable and operationally efficient solution for connecting a large number of VPCs (50 and growing) across multiple accounts and regions. TGW acts as a central hub, eliminating the need to manage numerous point-to-point VPC peering connections (which would result in high operational overhead for 50 VPCs). The TGW simplifies routing and management for the company's VPCs that need to communicate with each other.

answers.content: Create VPC peering connections between all the company's VPCs.
answers.explanation: With 50 VPCs, creating a full mesh of VPC peering connections would require N\*(N-1)/2 connections, resulting in 1,225 peering connections, which is significantly high operational overhead. This approach violates the requirement for the LEAST operational overhead.

answers.content: Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) that points to the compute resource for license validation. Create an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service that is available to each customer's VPAssociate the endpoint service with the NLB.
answers.explanation: The requirement for one-way access from each customer's VPC to a specific resource (license validator) in the management VPC is best met using AWS PrivateLink. PrivateLink allows customers to connect securely to the service hosted in the management VPC without requiring VPC peering or exposure to the public internet, satisfying the need for secure, low-overhead access to a single service. The Network Load Balancer is used to front the license validation service and create the endpoint service.

answers.content: Create a VPN appliance in each customer's VPC. Connect the company's management VPC to each customer's VPC by using AWS Site-to-Site VPN.
answers.explanation: This approach involves managing individual VPN connections, appliances, and incurring hourly VPN connection fees for each customer. This is complex, costly, and leads to high operational overhead compared to using AWS PrivateLink for a SaaS service offering.

answers.content: Create a VPC peering connection between the company's management VPC and each customer's VPC.
answers.explanation: While VPC peering could provide the required connectivity, managing individual peering connections for a growing number of customers is high operational overhead, especially when only one-way access to a specific application is required. AWS PrivateLink (Choice C) is specifically designed to provide low-overhead, secure access to services across VPCs and accounts without requiring peering relationships.

questions.content: A company wants to migrate an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster from an existing AWS account to a new AWS account in the same AWS Region. Both accounts are members of the same organization in AWS Organizations.  The company must minimize database service interruption before the company performs DNS cutover to the new databas Which migration strategy will meet this requirement? (Choose two.)

answers.content: Take a snapshot of the existing Aurora databasShare the snapshot with the new AWS account. Create an Aurora DB cluster in the new account from the snapshot.
answers.explanation:
Take a snapshot of the existing Aurora database. Share the snapshot with the new AWS account. Create an Aurora DB cluster in the new account from the snapshot.
This option provides an efficient way to perform the initial bulk data load across AWS accounts. By sharing an Aurora snapshot and restoring it in the target account, you establish the new database cluster with a copy of the source data. While snapshot creation and restoration involve some downtime, this method is a critical first step when combined with continuous replication (like AWS DMS) to achieve a near-zero downtime migration. For cross-account sharing of encrypted snapshots, a custom AWS KMS key must be used and shared with the target account.

answers.content: Create an Aurora DB cluster in the new AWS account. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate data between the two Aurora DB clusters.
answers.explanation: Create an Aurora DB cluster in the new AWS account. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate data between the two Aurora DB clusters.AWS DMS is the dedicated service for migrating databases with minimal downtime. It can replicate data continuously (Change Data Capture or CDC) from the source Aurora cluster to the target Aurora cluster after the initial data load (which can be done using the snapshot method in Option A). The continuous replication ensures that the target database stays in sync with the source, minimizing service interruption before the final DNS cutover. (Reference: AWS Database Migration Service documentation)

answers.content: Use AWS Backup to share an Aurora database backup from the existing AWS account to the new AWS account. Create an Aurora DB cluster in the new AWS account from the snapshot.
answers.explanation: AWS Backup is not typically used for Aurora DB cluster migration and may not support minimal downtime migration.

answers.content: Create an Aurora DB cluster in the new AWS account. Use AWS Application Migration Service to migrate data between the two Aurora DB clusters.
answers.explanation: AWS Application Migration Service is not designed for database migration and does not support Aurora clusters specifically.

questions.content: A company runs an application in the cloud that consists of a database and a websitUsers can post data to the website, have the data processed, and have the data sent back to them in an email. Data is stored in a MySQL database running on an Amazon EC2 instancThe database is running in a VPC with two private subnets. The website is running on Apache Tomcat in a single EC2 instance in a different VPC with one public subnet. There is a single VPC peering connection between the database and website VPC.  The website has suffered several outages during the last month due to high traffic.  Which actions should a solutions architect take to increase the reliability of the application? (Choose three.)

answers.content: Place the Tomcat server in an Auto Scaling group with multiple EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer.
answers.explanation: The website is currently running on a single EC2 instance and is experiencing outages due to high traffic. Placing it behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and in an Auto Scaling group (ASG) ensures that traffic is distributed across multiple instances, preventing overload on a single instance. The ASG also automatically scales capacity during traffic spikes and replaces unhealthy instances, significantly increasing reliability and availability. (Reference: AWS Documentation on Auto Scaling and Application Load Balancers for high availability and fault tolerance.)

answers.content: Provision an additional VPC peering connection.
answers.explanation: Provisioning an additional VPC peering connection is unnecessary as a single connection suffices for communication between two VPCs.

answers.content: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon Aurora with one Aurora Replica.
answers.explanation: The database is currently running on a single MySQL instance on Amazon EC2, which represents a single point of failure. Migrating to Amazon Aurora, an AWS managed relational database service, provides built-in fault tolerance and high availability. Adding an Aurora Replica further increases read scalability and offers a failover target, dramatically improving database reliability. (Reference: AWS Documentation on Amazon Aurora high availability and replication.)

answers.content: Provision two NAT gateways in the database VPC.
answers.explanation: NAT Gateways are used to allow instances in private subnets (like the database EC2 instance) to initiate outbound connections to the internet or other AWS services, while preventing inbound connections from the internet. The problem statement does not suggest any issues with the database needing outbound internet access, and provisioning NAT gateways does nothing to address the website traffic overload or the database's single point of failure.

answers.content: Move the Tomcat server to the database VPC.
answers.explanation: Moving the Tomcat server to the database VPC does not directly address reliability or scalability issues.

answers.content: Create an additional public subnet in a different Availability Zone in the website VPC.
answers.explanation: Adding another public subnet in a different Availability Zone allows the Auto Scaling group and load balancer to run the website across multiple AZs, eliminating a single point of failure and significantly improving availability.

questions.content: A company has developed a new release of a popular video game and wants to make it available for public download. The new release package is approximately 5 GB in sizThe company provides downloads for existing releases from a Linux-based, publicly facing FTP site hosted in an on-premises data center. The company expects the new release will be downloaded by users worldwidThe company wants a solution that provides improved download performance and low transfer costs, regardless of a user's location.

answers.content: Store the game files on Amazon EBS volumes mounted on Amazon EC2 instances within an Auto Scaling group. Configure an FTP service on the EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer in front of the Auto Scaling group. Publish the game download URL for users to download the package.
answers.explanation: Using EC2 instances with FTP and an Application Load Balancer is complex, less scalable, and less performant globally compared to S3 and CloudFront.

answers.content: Store the game files on Amazon EFS volumes that are attached to Amazon EC2 instances within an Auto Scaling group. Configure an FTP service on each of the EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer in front of the Auto Scaling group. Publish the game download URL for users to download the package.
answers.explanation: Similar to A but with EFS, which adds complexity and no significant performance advantage for public downloads versus S3 and CloudFront.

answers.content: Configure Amazon Route 53 and an Amazon S3 bucket for website hosting. Upload the game files to the S3 bucket. Use Amazon CloudFront for the websitPublish the game download URL for users to download the package.
answers.explanation: Amazon S3 combined with Amazon CloudFront provides a scalable, secure, and cost-effective way to distribute large files globally with low latency. CloudFront caches content closer to users worldwide, improving download performance regardless of location. Using managed services like S3 and CloudFront reduces operational overhead compared to managing FTP servers on EC2 instances. This approach avoids the complexity and security risks of running FTP services and leverages AWS best practices for file distribution.

answers.content: Configure Amazon Route 53 and an Amazon S3 bucket for website hosting. Upload the game files to the S3 bucket. Set Requester Pays for the S3 bucket. Publish the game download URL for users to download the package.
answers.explanation: Enabling Requester Pays increases cost burden on users and does not improve download performance or reduce transfer costs.

questions.content: A company is running its solution on AWS in a manually created VPC. The company is using AWS CloudFormation to provision other parts of the infrastructurAccording to a new requirement, the company must manage all infrastructure in an automatic way.  What should the company do to meet this new requirement with the LEAST effort?

answers.content: Create a new AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) stack that strictly provisions the existing VPC resources and configuration. Use AWS CDK to import the VPC into the stack and to manage the VPC.
answers.explanation: AWS CDK requires more effort to import existing resources compared to CloudFormation import and is not the simplest approach.

answers.content: Create a CloudFormation stack set that creates the VPC. Use the stack set to import the VPC into the stack.
answers.explanation: Stack sets are used for multi-account or multi-region deployments, not for importing existing resources into a stack.

answers.content: Create a new CloudFormation template that strictly provisions the existing VPC resources and configuration. From the CloudFormation console, create a new stack by importing the Existing resources.
answers.explanation: AWS CloudFormation supports importing existing resources into a new stack using a CloudFormation template, which allows managing manually created infrastructure automatically with the least effort. Using a CloudFormation template to import the existing VPC leverages the managed CloudFormation service aligned with best practices for infrastructure as codAWS CDK or AWS SAM are more suitable for new infrastructure creation and may require more effort to recreate or manage existing resources. Stack sets focus on deploying stacks across multiple accounts or regions and are not specifically designed for importing existing resources.

answers.content: Create a new CloudFormation template that creates the VPC. Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI to import the VPC.
answers.explanation: AWS SAM is designed for serverless applications and does not provide specific capabilities for importing VPC resources.

questions.content: A company has implemented a new security requirement. According to the new requirement, the company must scan all traffic from corporate AWS instances in the company's VPC for violations of the company's security policies. As a result of these scans, the company can block access to and from specific IP addresses.  To meet the new requirement, the company deploys a set of Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets to serve as transparent proxies. The company installs approved proxy server software on these EC2 instances. The company modifies the route tables on all subnets to use the corresponding EC2 instances with proxy software as the default routThe company also creates security groups that are compliant with the security policies and assigns these security groups to the EC2 instances.  Despite these configurations, the traffic of the EC2 instances in their private subnets is not being properly forwarded to the internet.  What should a solutions architect do to resolve this issue?

answers.content: Disable source/destination checks on the EC2 instances that run the proxy software.
answers.explanation: When an EC2 instance is used as a proxy or a router, source/destination checks must be disabled to allow the instance to forward traffic that is not specifically addressed to itself. The question involves EC2 instances acting as transparent proxies for routing and scanning traffic, which requires disabling source/destination checks. The key facts mention routing and internet gateways but do not mention adding network interfaces or changing DHCP options as a solution for traffic forwarding. Security groups allowing traffic is important but does not resolve traffic forwarding issues caused by source/destination checks.

answers.content: Add a rule to the security group that is assigned to the proxy EC2 instances to allow all traffic between instances that have this security group. Assign this security group to all EC2 instances in the VPC.
answers.explanation: Security group changes alone won’t enable the EC2 proxy instances to forward traffic correctly if source/destination checks are enabled.

answers.content: Change the VPCs DHCP options set. Set the DNS server options to point to the addresses of the proxy EC2 instances.
answers.explanation: Changing DHCP options to point DNS to proxy instances does not affect traffic routing or forwarding.

answers.content: Assign one additional elastic network interface to each proxy EC2 instancEnsure that one of these network interfaces has a route to the private subnets. Ensure that the other network interface has a route to the internet.
answers.explanation: Adding additional network interfaces is unnecessary and not a standard solution to enable traffic forwarding for proxies.

questions.content: A company wants to migrate its website to AWS. The website uses microservices and runs on containers that are deployed in an on-premises, self-managed Kubernetes cluster. All the manifests that define the deployments for the containers in the Kubernetes deployment are in source control.  All data for the website is stored in a PostgreSQL databasAn open source container image repository runs alongside the on-premises environment.  A solutions architect needs to determine the architecture that the company will use for the website on AWS.  Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST effort to migrate?

answers.content: Create an AWS App Runner servicConnect the App Runner service to the open source container image repository. Deploy the manifests from on premises to the App Runner servicCreate an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database.
answers.explanation: App Runner does not support deploying Kubernetes manifests and is less suitable for microservices originally deployed in Kubernetes.

answers.content: Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster that has managed node groups. Copy the application containers to a new Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Deploy the manifests from on premises to the EKS cluster. Create an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
answers.explanation: Amazon EKS is a managed Kubernetes service, which aligns well with the existing on-premises Kubernetes deployment, reducing migration effort. Using managed node groups in EKS simplifies cluster management compared to self-managed Kubernetes on EC2 instances. Migrating container images to Amazon ECR is a best practice for container image management on AWS. Creating an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster provides a managed, scalable, and highly available database servicThis approach leverages managed AWS services, ensuring security best practices and minimal changes to existing deployment manifests.

answers.content: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that has an Amazon EC2 capacity pool. Copy the application containers to a new Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Register each container image as a new task definition. Configure ECS services for each task definition to match the original Kubernetes deployments. Create an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
answers.explanation: Amazon ECS is not Kubernetes and requires converting manifests to ECS task definitions, increasing migration effort.

answers.content: Rebuild the on-premises Kubernetes cluster by hosting the cluster on Amazon EC2 instances. Migrate the open source container image repository to the EC2 instances. Deploy the manifests from on premises to the new cluster on AWS. Deploy an open source PostgreSQL database on the new cluster.
answers.explanation: Rebuilding a self-managed Kubernetes cluster on EC2 and running an open source PostgreSQL database increases management overhead and effort, less secure and less managed.

questions.content: A company provides a centralized Amazon EC2 application hosted in a single shared VPC. The centralized application must be accessible from client applications running in the VPCs of other business units. The centralized application front end is configured with a Network Load Balancer (NLB) for scalability.  Up to 10 business unit VPCs will need to be connected to the shared VPC. Some of the business unit VPC CIDR blocks overlap with the shared VPC, and some overlap with each other Network connectivity to the centralized application in the shared VPC should be allowed from authorized business unit VPCs only.  Which network configuration should a solutions architect use to provide connectivity from the client applications in the business unit VPCs to the centralized application in the shared VPC?

answers.content: Create an AWS Transit Gateway. Attach the shared VPC and the authorized business unit VPCs to the transit gateway. Create a single transit gateway route table and associate it with all of the attached VPCs. Allow automatic propagation of routes from the attachments into the route tablConfigure VPC routing tables to send traffic to the transit gateway.
answers.explanation: Transit Gateway cannot support overlapping CIDRs between the shared and business unit VPCs, making it unsuitable.

answers.content: Create a VPC endpoint service using the centralized application NLB and enable the option to require endpoint acceptancCreate a VPC endpoint in each of the business unit VPCs using the service name of the endpoint servicAccept authorized endpoint requests from the endpoint service console.
answers.explanation: VPC endpoint services with NLB support allow private connectivity from multiple VPCs, enabling secure and scalable access to a centralized application. Using VPC endpoint services avoids overlapping CIDR block conflicts common with VPC peering or Transit Gateway in this scenario. Endpoint acceptance ensures only authorized VPCs connect, maintaining fine-grained access control over connectivity. This approach follows AWS best practices by leveraging managed services designed for secure service connectivity without complex network overlapping issues.

answers.content: Create a VPC peering connection from each business unit VPC to the shared VPAccept the VPC peering connections from the shared VPC consolConfigure VPC routing tables to send traffic to the VPC peering connection.
answers.explanation: VPC peering does not support overlapping CIDRs, causing routing conflicts for overlapping business unit VPCs.

answers.content: Configure a virtual private gateway for the shared VPC and create customer gateways for each of the authorized business unit VPCs. Establish a Site-to-Site VPN connection from the business unit VPCs to the shared VPC. Configure VPC routing tables to send traffic to the VPN connection.
answers.explanation: Using Site-to-Site VPN and customer gateways is operationally heavy and less secure compared to managed endpoint services.

questions.content: A company runs a highly available data collection application on Amazon EC2 in the eu-north-1 Region. The application collects data from end-user devices and writes records to an Amazon Kinesis data stream and a set of AWS Lambda functions that process the records. The company persists the output of the record processing to an Amazon S3 bucket in eu-north-1. The company uses the data in the S3 bucket as a data source for Amazon Athena.  The company wants to increase its global presencA solutions architect must launch the data collection capabilities in the sa-east-1 and ap-northeast-1 Regions. The solutions architect deploys the application, the Kinesis data stream, and the Lambda functions in the two new Regions. The solutions architect keeps the S3 bucket in eu-north-1 to meet a requirement to centralize the data analysis.  During testing of the new setup, the solutions architect notices a significant lag on the arrival of data from the new Regions to the S3 bucket.  Which solution will improve this lag time the MOST?

answers.content: In each of the two new Regions, set up the Lambda functions to run in a VPC. Set up an S3 gateway endpoint in that VPC.
answers.explanation: Using a VPC endpoint improves security but does not reduce global upload latency across distant regions.

answers.content: Turn on S3 Transfer Acceleration on the S3 bucket in eu-north-1. Change the application to use the new S3 accelerated endpoint when the application uploads data to the S3 bucket.
answers.explanation: S3 Transfer Acceleration uses optimized network paths and Amazon CloudFront edge locations to transfer data to S3 buckets with lower latency. The problem is network lag uploading data from remote regions to a centralized S3 bucket, which Transfer Acceleration specifically addresses. This solution improves upload speed without requiring changes to application architecture or additional replication steps. Security is maintained as data is transmitted securely to the original centralized bucket using managed AWS infrastructure.

answers.content: Create an S3 bucket in each of the two new Regions. Set the application in each new Region to upload to its respective S3 bucket. Set up S3 Cross-Region Replication to replicate data to the S3 bucket in eu-north-1.
answers.explanation: Cross-region replication incurs eventual consistency and does not improve initial upload lag; it adds complexity.

answers.content: Increase the memory requirements of the Lambda functions to ensure that they have multiple cores availablUse the multipart upload feature when the application uploads data to Amazon S3 from Lambda.
answers.explanation: Increasing Lambda memory or using multipart uploads may improve processing or large upload efficiency locally but does not reduce network latency issues globally.

questions.content: A company has developed an application that is running Windows Server on VMware vSphere VMs that the company hosts on premises. The application data is stored in a proprietary format that must be read through the application. The company manually provisioned the servers and the application.  As part of its disaster recovery plan, the company wants the ability to host its application on AWS temporarily if the company's on-premises environment becomes unavailablThe company wants the application to return to on-premises hosting after a disaster recovery event is completThe RPO is 5 minutes.  Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

answers.content: Configure AWS DataSync. Replicate the data to Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. When the on-premises environment is unavailable, use AWS CloudFormation templates to provision Amazon EC2 instances and attach the EBS volumes.
answers.explanation: Using AWS DataSync and manual provisioning with CloudFormation involves more operational overhead and is not optimized for disaster recovery automation.

answers.content: Configure AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery. Replicate the data to replication Amazon EC2 instances that are attached to Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. When the on-premises environment is unavailable, use Elastic Disaster Recovery to launch EC2 instances that use the replicated volumes.
answers.explanation: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery is a managed service designed specifically for disaster recovery scenarios, minimizing operational overhead by automating replication and failover processes. Elastic Disaster Recovery replicates data continuously to EC2 instances with attached EBS volumes, enabling a near-real-time recovery point objective (RPO) of 5 minutes or less. Using Elastic Disaster Recovery aligns with AWS best practices by leveraging a managed service tailored for disaster recovery, reducing manual management and complexity compared to building custom solutions with DataSync or Storage Gateway. Other solutions require more manual steps or do not directly support the desired RPO and failover capability with as little operational overhead.

answers.content: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway. Replicate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. When the on-premises environment is unavailable, use AWS Backup to restore the data to Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes and launch Amazon EC2 instances from these EBS volumes.
answers.explanation: Storage Gateway with AWS Backup requires manual restoring and provisioning, increasing operational complexity and potentially not meeting the 5-minute RPO.

answers.content: Provision an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system on AWS. Replicate the data to the file system. When the on-premises environment is unavailable, use AWS CloudFormation templates to provision Amazon EC2 instances and use AWS::CloudFormation::Init commands to mount the Amazon FSx file shares.
answers.explanation: Using Amazon FSx and CloudFormation Init commands to mount shares involves more complex setup and manual failover, increasing operational overhead.

questions.content: To abide by industry regulations, a solutions architect must design a solution that will store a company's critical data in multiple public AWS Regions, including in the United States, where the company's headquarters is located. The solutions architect is required to provide access to the data stored in AWS to the company’s global WAN network. The security team mandates that no traffic accessing this data should traverse the public internet.  How should the solutions architect design a highly available solution that meets the requirements and is cost-effective?

answers.content: Establish AWS Direct Connect connections from the company headquarters to all AWS Regions in usUse the company WAN to send traffic over to the headquarters and then to the respective DX connection to access the data.
answers.explanation: Establishing Direct Connect connections to all AWS Regions is not cost-effective and unnecessary due to Direct Connect Gateway.

answers.content: Establish two AWS Direct Connect connections from the company headquarters to an AWS Region. Use the company WAN to send traffic over a DX connection. Use inter-region VPC peering to access the data in other AWS Regions.
answers.explanation: Inter-region VPC peering does not provide private WAN-wide connectivity; it also has limitations scaling across multiple regions.

answers.content: Establish two AWS Direct Connect connections from the company headquarters to an AWS Region. Use the company WAN to send traffic over a DX connection. Use an AWS transit VPC solution to access data in other AWS Regions.
answers.explanation: An AWS transit VPC solution is more complex and less preferred over managed Direct Connect Gateway service for multi-region access.

answers.content: Establish two AWS Direct Connect connections from the company headquarters to an AWS Region. Use the company WAN to send traffic over a DX connection. Use Direct Connect Gateway to access data in other AWS Regions.
answers.explanation: Using AWS Direct Connect provides private connectivity from the company's WAN to AWS, avoiding public internet. Direct Connect Gateway allows access to multiple AWS Regions through a single DX connection, enabling highly available and cost-effective inter-region access. This approach aligns with security best practices by preventing data traffic from traversing the public internet and reducing complexity compared to establishing multiple DX connections or VPC peering across regions. It is a managed AWS service designed to simplify multi-region access with private connectivity.

questions.content: A medical company is running a REST API on a set of Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB runs in three public subnets, and the EC2 instances run in three private subnets. The company has deployed an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has the ALB as the only origin.  Which solution should a solutions architect recommend to enhance the origin security?

answers.content: Store a random string in AWS Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function for automatic secret rotation. Configure CloudFront to inject the random string as a custom HTTP header for the origin request. Create an AWS WAF web ACL rule with a string match rule for the custom header. Associate the web ACL with the ALB.
answers.explanation: Using AWS Secrets Manager for storing a random string and rotating it automatically ensures secure management of secrets per AWS best practices. Configuring CloudFront to inject the secret as a custom HTTP header and using AWS WAF to allow requests only with this header enhances origin security by validating requests from the CloudFront distribution. This approach leverages managed AWS services for secret management, rotation, and web traffic filtering, aligning with security best practices. The key facts emphasize the importance of IAM roles and minimal permissions, which is consistent with secure and managed secret handling as in option A.

answers.content: Create an AWS WAF web ACL rule with an IP match condition of the CloudFront service IP address ranges. Associate the web ACL with the ALMove the ALB into the three private subnets.
answers.explanation: Moving ALB to private subnets is not possible as ALBs require at least one public subnet and IP matching CloudFront IP ranges is not recommended due to IP address changes and maintenance.
